rows.conclusion: Queues, gathered inputs, executor host outputs, materialized Level/population and final compaction use budgeted Buffer/pages while simultaneous storage remains live.

DeviceArray counts bytes diagnostically, then cudaMalloc, with no effective budget reservation/cap and no checked count*sizeof(T) or cumulative addition. Caller MemoryBudget admits only host Buffer payloads. Runtime/context/device stack and any implicit staging are separate, not included in device_bytes.
Unresolved leaf contributes zero records/incidences and no resolved ledger; fill skips it; fallback recomputes its full leaf with deferred batch disabled.

Count and fill consume the same immutable leaf inputs; exclusive output ranges are checked after fill. CPU prefix uses checked_add. CUDA total/product additions are unchecked; do not claim an admitted-input overflow or wrong result was demonstrated.

Public path rejects nonunit multiplicities and kmax outside 1..12, preserves valid ordered SiteIdx lists in certified T0 leaves, and queues only 1..32 sites. Internal LeafBatchView/queue are not foreign-input validators.

Kernel phases synchronize before host consumption, arrays are RAII-owned until CUDA executor returns. No device leak/quiescence certification is inferred from source; destructor ignores cudaFree return.
Partial local executor/materialization buffers do not publish a successful Catalogue; public diagnostics/timings swap only after success and Assembly::finish returns final Catalogue.

geometry_passes=1 describes one catalogue front/storage route, whereas resolved batch leaves run geometry in count and fill; unresolved leaves add a CPU fallback. Keep one logical ledger; separately disclose physical enumeration work.
CUDA route is optional and sanitizer incompatibility declared. This review does not compile or qualify nvcc, kernels, native output, CPU/GPU parity, FULL performance or the 100ms contract.
